mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_request (student_id, teacher_id, class_id, request_type, request_date, reason, status, reply_remark, create_time, handle_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{requestType}, #{requestDate}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{replyRemark}, #{createTime}, #{handleTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student_request WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM student_request WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM student_request ORDER BY request_id DESC
